proposals.label: river
proposals.notes: Compare Kati nanī, Waigali nãdī and Gawarbati nēndi. Turner explicitly derives Dameli nalī via early *nandī > *nanī; Nuristani connection, borrowing not established.

proposals.label: leg
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli khur foot, Pashai khurī hoof/heel and Palula khur hoof. Extension from hoof/foot to leg; same family as previously approved foot.

proposals.label: husband's brother
proposals.notes: Compare Gawarbati dēr, Palula dīr and Kalasha diór. Specific dēvará section; includes broader brother-in-law glosses, excludes compounds.

proposals.label: grapes
proposals.notes: Borrowed via Indo-Aryan *drākkha, following Turner; immediate language unresolved. Compare Gawarbati/Shumasti lāk. Contrast Nuristani Kati drås and Waigali drās, not evidence of a Nuristani donor here.

proposals.label: shirt
proposals.notes: Tentative paridhāna family; compare Palula perōṇ and Torwali puān shirt. Turner also explicitly allows Persian pērāhan as source for Dameli (as for Khowar pirāan). Alternative possible Persian borrowing retained; transmission unresolved.

proposals.label: knife
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli kaṭērī small dagger, Ashkun katarä dagger and Gawarbati kaṭāro large knife. Nuristani comparison and possible regional borrowing, donor unresolved. Excludes mixed survey cākū / kaṭerī record.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 79, example (22), w3, y 511, data E0016]

proposals.label: watermill
proposals.etymon_gloss: controlling device; any implement or contrivance
proposals.notes: Compare Pashai žantr and Palula yāndr watermill; Turner explicitly includes Dameli žan under yantra. Source tone retained.

proposals.label: hide
proposals.notes: Tentative correspondence to Turner Dameli wailʸāy cover/wrap up under causative *abhilāyayati. Compare Prakrit ahilāṇa face-covering and Bengali helāna lean against; valency and semantic development to hide qualified. Excludes added causative forms.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 99, Table 29, cell 1, y 366];perder2013dameli[p. 208, Table 48, cell 2, y 339]
perder2013dameli[p. 102, Table 31, cell 1, y 441];perder2013dameli[p. 104, Table 32, cell 1, y 399]

proposals.label: burn intransitive
proposals.notes: Compare Turner Dameli luṣ be burnt, Kati luṣ burn and Punjabi lūsṇā burn with anger. Specific *lūṣyatē intransitive section; Nuristani parallel, borrowing not established.

proposals.label: burn transitive
proposals.notes: Compare Turner Dameli loṣ roast, Gawarbati loṣ burn and Khowar paz loṣik have heartburn. Specific *lōṣati section; keeps transitive and intransitive Dameli stems separate.

proposals.label: shear
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli niäṭh cut/shear, Palula nyāṭ shear wool and Kashmiri nĕtun shear. Transcription/aspiration variation qualified.

proposals.label: under
proposals.notes: Compare Kati nyiŕe down and Kalasha nə̃ŕuna below. Earlier Dameli nyε̃ŕa under/below. Nuristani connection, borrowing not established.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 131, example (77), w3, y 468, data Q1001];perder2013dameli[p. 131, prose, y 406, x 233, data Q1033]

proposals.label: chew
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli ċapāy chew, Shina čapóĭki̯ and Pali cappēti. Expressive family; includes cap eat hard things with affricate/palatal transcription variation qualified.

proposals.label: split
proposals.notes: Compare Palula phāl tear and Kashmiri phālawun split. Specific transitive phālayati section, not intransitive phálati.

proposals.label: found
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli ladyem I obtained, Wotapuri lād found and Palula lādu. Suppletive perfective lad-, separate from present lai-.

proposals.label: find
proposals.notes: Compare Pashai lay- and Khowar leik find, Ashkun low- obtain. Nuristani comparison, borrowing not established. Turner also considers *labhayati for some regional forms.

proposals.label: word
proposals.notes: Borrowed from another Indo-Aryan language, immediate donor unresolved, following Turner's explicit classification of Dardic forms. Compare Gawarbati bāti and Palula bāt. CDIAL cached text prints wood for Dameli, apparent typo against word/speech comparanda and Perder; do not copy typo into gloss.

proposals.label: boy
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli pāi son, Bashkarik pō son/boy and Torwali pō child. Excludes goat pāī/pay homonyms and put which belongs to putra family.

proposals.label: mother-in-law
proposals.notes: Compare Palula preṣ, Kalasha isprε̃s, Khowar išpreṣí and Ashkun šipôs. Nuristani comparison, borrowing not established; excludes jeṣṭāli alternative word.

proposals.label: intelligent
proposals.etymon_gloss: right, proper; competent, clever; healthy, prosperous; well-being
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli kušula, Kati kšulə and Prasun kᵘšul clever/wise. Possible Nuristani mediation; donor unestablished. Aspiration in Perder kʰuśala qualified; do not silently equate with Persian xuš happy.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 175, example (147), w3, y 440, data T0005]

proposals.label: mango
proposals.etymon_gloss: mango tree, Mangifera indica; its fruit
proposals.notes: Compare Hindi/Urdu ām and Sindhi āmo mango. Probable regional loan, donor unresolved; āmrá family rather than assertion of direct inheritance. Excludes ām common.

proposals.label: banana
proposals.notes: Compare Hindi/Urdu kelā and Punjabi kēlā banana. Probable regional loan, donor unresolved; kadala family rather than assertion of direct inheritance.

proposals.label: chili
proposals.notes: Compare Kashmiri mariċ black pepper and Nepali maric. Specific *maricca family; semantic transfer from pepper to chili, probable regional borrowing with donor unresolved.

proposals.label: oil
proposals.etymon_gloss: fluid grease, clarified butter or ghee
proposals.notes: Tentative ghr̥ta family; compare Wotapuri gíu, Nepali ghiu and Kashmiri gyĕv ghee. Perder gloss oil may be broader than ghee; earlier Dameli giŕu has a different extension. Regional borrowing possible, donor unresolved.

proposals.label: who
proposals.notes: Compare Khowar ka and Pashai kī who; Kati/Waigali kī. Nuristani comparisons, borrowing not established. Includes only who glosses, not kā where; oblique/compound forms deferred.

proposals.notes: Oblique first-person singular family; compare Khowar ma me, Kashmiri mĕ and Sindhi mū̃ I/by me. Exact vowel and case formation of Dameli mū unresolved; not reconstructed as direct continuation of a specific Sanskrit case form.

proposals.label: same
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli sam equal/like, Pashai sam straight and Sinhala sama equal. Long vowel of survey sām qualified.

proposals.label: now
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli žā now, Waigali āzə and Palula āj today. Turner proposes *adyaka/*adyāka extension for Dameli; Nuristani comparison, borrowing not established.

proposals.label: eighth
proposals.notes: Compare Pali aṭṭhama, Prakrit aṭṭhama and Maiya aṭhō̃ eighth. Could be a transparent ordinal formation on Dameli aṣṭ rather than uninterrupted inheritance of whole word; family placement.

proposals.label: become warm
proposals.notes: Compare Prakrit tavaï is hot, Kashmiri tawun roast and Gujarati tavvũ be heated. Proposed tápati family; distinct from previously approved causative tāp.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 99, Table 30, cell 1, y 541];perder2013dameli[p. 208, Table 48, cell 2, y 143]

proposals.label: freeze
proposals.notes: Tentative semantic development burn to frostbite/freeze: Turner explicitly compares Dameli oṣē be frostbitten and Khowar uṣák cold under oṣati. His alternative root notation uṣ- retained.

proposals.label: rub
proposals.notes: Compare Pali makkhēti smear, Romani makh- rub and Bengali mākhā knead/smear. Proposed mrakṣati family; no direct Dameli citation in Turner, regional borrowing possible.

proposals.label: accept
proposals.notes: Compare Shina manóĭki̯ agree/obey and Punjabi manṇā believe. Proposed manyate family, with manutē/*manvati an alternative; donor/pathway unresolved.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 130, example (74), w2, y 54, data TW5008]

proposals.label: suck
proposals.notes: Compare Shina čŭṣóĭki̯ suck and Hindi cūsnā/cū̃snā. Proposed cūṣati family, possible *cūṣyati formation; nasalization qualified, borrowing unresolved.

proposals.label: hundred thousand
proposals.notes: Probable regional Indo-Aryan loan: compare Shina lăk (explicitly borrowed in Turner) and Punjabi lakh. Perder p. 144 example (90) explicitly translates five lakh rupees, confirming source gloss lac means 100,000, not lac resin.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 144, example (90), w5, y 111, data TW1072]

proposals.label: young
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli suräi, Pashai sūṛ/suṛā small/young and Kashmiri śur infant. *śuḍa family with s- variant recognized by Turner. Includes lexicalized younger brother/sister uses; excludes ucuṭa family.

proposals.label: count
proposals.notes: Proposed denominal counting verb from lēkhya accounts; compare Torwali lekūsa count and Palula lεkhūm I count/divide. Kind derived. Alternatives via lēkhayati writes and regional borrowing remain open; not secure direct inheritance of a Sanskrit verb meaning count.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 95, Table 27, cell 2, y 147];perder2013dameli[p. 207, Table 48, cell 2, y 552]

proposals.label: red
proposals.notes: Compare earlier Dameli lāc̣hā red, Punjabi lākkhā reddish/brown and Kalasha lac̣hīa (related lākṣika formation). Specific *lākṣaka section; extra lai- element in survey forms unresolved.

proposals.label: send
proposals.notes: Proposed *sājayati family; compare Ashkun ṣā send, Wotapuri šā send/kindle and Gawarbati ṣa send/hit. Possible Nuristani mediation, donor unresolved. Turner also discusses competing śrāyayati and coalescence with śrayati; includes scoop food extension provisionally.

forms.Source: perder2013dameli[p. 143, example (89), w5, y 441, data TW5006]

proposals.label: dry
proposals.notes: Proposed *śuṣkati becomes dry, denominative of śuṣka; compare Shumasti sux-, Kashmiri hŏkhun and Hindi sūkhnā. Dameli śōk vowel and transitivity require qualification; no direct Dameli citation in Turner.
